PWC_ai_prepare_U00_air_power = {
    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_air_power
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = U00 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = U00 }
                is_neighbor_of = U00
                U00 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    U00 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = U00
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = U00 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = U00 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = U00 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = U00 }
        U00 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = U00
        value = 103
    }
}

    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_mobility
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = U68 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = U68 }
                is_neighbor_of = U68
                U68 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    U68 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = U68
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = U68 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = U68 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = U68 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = U68 }
        U68 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = U68
        value = 105
    }
}

    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_defense
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = U76 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = U76 }
                is_neighbor_of = U76
                U76 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    U76 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = U76
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = U76 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = U76 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = U76 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = U76 }
        U76 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes

    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_air_power
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = V30 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = V30 }
                is_neighbor_of = V30
                V30 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    V30 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = V30
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = V30 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = V30 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = V30 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = V30 }
        V30 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = V30
        value = 103
    }
}

    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_mobility
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = V47 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = V47 }
                is_neighbor_of = V47
                V47 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    V47 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = V47
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = V47 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = V47 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = V47 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = V47 }
        V47 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = V47
        value = 105
    }
}

    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_air_power
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = W09 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = W09 }
                is_neighbor_of = W09
                W09 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    W09 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = W09
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = W09 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = W09 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = W09 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = W09 }
        W09 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = W09
        value = 103
    }
}

    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_mobility
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = W26 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = W26 }
                is_neighbor_of = W26
                W26 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    W26 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = W26
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = W26 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = W26 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = W26 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = W26 }
        W26 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = W26
        value = 105
    }
}

PWC_ai_prepare_W34_defense = {
    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_defense
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = W34 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = W34 }
                is_neighbor_of = W34
                W34 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    W34 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = W34
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = W34 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = W34 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = W34 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = W34 }
        W34 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = W34
        value = 90
    }

    allowed = {
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_air_power
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = W88 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = W88 }
                is_neighbor_of = W88
                W88 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    W88 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = W88
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = W88 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = W88 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = W88 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = W88 }
        W88 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = W88
        value = 103
    }
}

    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_mobility
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = X05 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = X05 }
                is_neighbor_of = X05
                X05 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    X05 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = X05
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = X05 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = X05 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = X05 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = X05 }
        X05 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
            has_capitulated = no
            NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        }
    }
    abort_when_not_enabled = yes
    ai_strategy = {
        type = prepare_for_war
        id = X05
        value = 105
    }
}

    }
    enable = {
        has_country_flag = pwc_ai_defense
        is_ai = yes
        pwc_st_is_city_country = yes
        pwc_st_city_alive = yes
        has_capitulated = no
        NOT = { pwc_st_protection_active = yes }
        NOT = { tag = X13 }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_reserved
                has_variable = pwc_coalition_target
                var:pwc_coalition_target = { tag = X13 }
                is_neighbor_of = X13
                X13 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_coalition_pending }
            }
            AND = {
                pwc_st_ai_war_pacing_ready = yes
                OR = {
                    X13 = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_from_@ROOT }
                    AND = {
                        NOT = { has_country_flag = pwc_flag_warning_active }
                        is_neighbor_of = X13
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        NOT = { has_war_with = X13 }
        NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = X13 }
        NOT = { has_truce_with = X13 }
        NOT = { is_in_faction_with = X13 }
        X13 = {
            exists = yes
            pwc_st_city_alive = yes
